main_text.p: matum plebi divisisset, aurato bove honorârunt.a Exod.16.4. aIudæis verò, majori annonæ inopia conflictantibus, Deus, manna cœlitus misso, succurrerat: {b}depluit super eos manna ad comedendum, & frumentum cœlorum dedit illis.b Psal.78.24. Quapropter erat causa cur simulacro potiùs bovis, quàm ovis, aut cujuscunque alius rei, Deum colerent, etsi bovem Apim videre in Ægypto nequaquam assueverant. Nisi forte dicet Bellarminus nullam ne Romanis quidem causam fuisse cur bove potiùs, quàm ove, aut aliquâ re alia, Minucium gloriæ commendarent, nisi quoniam Apim bovem assueverant videre in Ægypto: qui, haud scio an illo ævo vel Ægypti, nedum bovis Apidis, nomen audierint. Quid? Ante Ægyptiis item affirmabit nullam reddi posse causam cur bove potiùs, quàm ove, frumentariam Serapidis beneficentiam celebrarent, nisi quia in alia nescio qua Ægypto Apim bovem viderant? Aut potuit hujus rei forma in mentem venire Ægyptiis, & Romanis; Iudæis non potuit: quorum patriarcha {c}Ioseph Pharaoni oftenderat Deum somnio de septem bobus pinguibus, septem macilentis, significasse annos septenos saturitatis & famis, quòd boves animalia sint ad aratrum nata, ut historicus Iudæus {d}Iosephus arbitratur? Quò facit, quòd boves saturi, quales ubertatem annonæ in Pharaonis somnio designabant, {e}numerantur inter præcipua strenui & industrii coloni instrumenta, quibus ager frugum ferax efficitur. Atque hoc potuit innui Pharaonis bobus, etsi boves fœminæ fuerint, quas vidit: quandoquidem {f}vaccis arant, ubi terra levis est; {g}qualis Ægyptus à Nilo
{f} Varr. de re rust. lib.1. c.20.

page.notes: Marginal notes are placed as close as possible to their reference marks; the exact position of the mark letters a–g in the text is approximate. The footnote-style references in the right margin (Gen., Antiquit., Plin., Varr., Diodor. Sic., Herodot., Plin. natur.) are transcribed as printed. "Diodor. Sic. lib.1. part.2." is printed in the margin at the foot of the text and was not placed as a separate paragraph in the main text; it is lost in this transcription and should be checked. Line-end hyphen "Io-seph", "Phá-raonis" and "a-rant" restored without spaces. Some letters in the margin are not fully legible; "Iud." and "Diodor." are doubtful.
